info.name: CollabMedia - Stream Comments & Likes API
info.description:
APIs for managing comments and likes on stream posts. Includes post-level interactions (StreamComments, StreamLikes) for social features within streams.

**Authentication:**
All endpoints require JWT authentication. Include the JWT token in the Authorization header:
`Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>`

The JWT middleware will automatically map the token to req.session.user for compatibility with session-based code.

item.name: Post Comments

request.description:
Add a new comment to a specific post. Creates a record in StreamComments collection.

**Parameters:**
- `SocialPageId`: Stream/Page ID
- `SocialPostId`: Post ID
- `hexcode_blendedImage`: Blend version identifier
- `Comment`: Comment text
- `PrivacySetting`: "PublicWithName" | "PublicWithoutName" | "OnlyForOwner" | "InvitedFriends"
- `Members`: Array of member IDs (for privacy filtering)
- `StreamId`: Stream ID (for notifications)
- `PostOwnerId`: Post owner ID (for notifications)

Edit an existing comment. Provide the comment `id` to update instead of creating new.

**Parameters:**
- `id`: Comment ID to edit
- `Comment`: New comment text
- Other fields same as Add Comment

Soft delete a comment (sets IsDeleted: true). Only the comment owner can delete.

**Parameters:**
- `id`: Comment ID to delete
- `SocialPageId`: Stream/Page ID
- `Members`: Array of member IDs

Get all top-level comments for a stream (no parent comments). Filters by privacy settings.

**Parameters:**
- `SocialPageId`: Stream/Page ID
- `Members`: Array of member IDs (for filtering InvitedFriends privacy)

item.name: Comment Likes (StreamCommentLikes)

request.description:
✅ Like a comment or reply using StreamCommentLikes collection.

**Route:** `/journal/addLike` (✅ ROUTED)

**Works for both:**
- Regular comments (ParentId = null)
- Replies to comments (ParentId exists)

**Collection:** StreamCommentLikes

**Parameters:**
- `CommentId`: Comment/Reply ID (works for both!)
- `SocialPageId`: Stream ID

**Features:**
- ✅ Prevents duplicate likes
- ✅ Returns likeId for easy removal
- ✅ User automatically from session

**Response:**
Returns likeId which can be used to remove the like later.

✅ Remove like using the like _id (recommended - simpler).

**Parameters:**
- `_id`: Like ID (from addLike response)
- `SocialPageId`: Stream ID (for fetching updated list)

**Alternative:** Can also use CommentId (see next request)

item.name: Remove Like from Comment/Reply (StreamCommentLikes) - Using CommentId

request.description:
Remove like using CommentId (backward compatible method).

**Parameters:**
- `CommentId`: Comment/Reply ID
- `SocialPageId`: Stream ID

Get all comment likes for streams, pages, or both.

**Collection:** StreamCommentLikes

**Parameters:**
- `StreamId`: Stream/Capsule ID (optional - filters by stream)
- `SocialPageId`: Stream/Capsule ID (alias for StreamId, backward compatibility)
- `PageId`: Page ID (optional - filters by page, gets likes for comments on posts in that page)

**Filtering Options:**
1. **Stream only**: `{ "StreamId": "..." }` - All likes in the stream
2. **Page only**: `{ "PageId": "..." }` - All likes for posts in that page
3. **Both**: `{ "StreamId": "...", "PageId": "..." }` - Likes in page within stream

**Note:** `SocialPageId` actually stores StreamId, not PageId!

**Returns:** All comment likes with `IsReply`, `ParentId`, and `LikedBy` fields

item.description:
✅ APIs for liking comments and replies using StreamCommentLikes collection.

**Routes:** All routes are now configured in `journalRoutes.js` (✅ VERIFIED)

**Note:** These use StreamCommentLikes collection (same as scrpt), not MediaActionLogs.

**Works for both:**
- Comments (ParentId = null)
- Replies to comments (ParentId exists)

Both use the same CommentId parameter since replies are also stored as comments with ParentId.

**Alternative:** Use `/mediaAction/addCommentLike` which uses MediaActionLogs collection.

item.name: Stream-Level Actions (MediaActionLogs)

request.description:
Like an entire stream (not a specific post). Uses MediaActionLogs with ActionLevel='stream'.

**Parameters:**
- `StreamId`: Capsule/Stream ID
- `SocialPageId`: Same as StreamId (for compatibility)
- `PostOwnerId`: Stream owner ID (for notifications)

**Creates:**
```json
{
  "StreamId": ObjectId,
  "UserId": ObjectId,
  "Action": "Vote",
  "ActionLevel": "stream",
  "LikeType": "1",
  "IsDeleted": false
}
```

Remove a stream-level like. Soft deletes from MediaActionLogs.

**Parameters:**
- `StreamId`: Capsule/Stream ID
- `SocialPageId`: Same as StreamId

Get all stream-level likes from MediaActionLogs.

**Parameters:**
- `StreamId`: Capsule/Stream ID

**Note:** This is different from post-level likes in StreamLikes collection.

item.description: APIs for liking entire streams (not individual posts) using MediaActionLogs collection with ActionLevel='stream'.

item.name: Query APIs

request.description:
Get all undelivered posts where the user has commented or liked.

**Auto-fetches:**
- `StreamIds`: User's owned streams (if not provided)
- `Members`: Stream members (if not provided)

**Parameters:**
- `UserEmail`: User's email (required)
- `StreamIds`: Array of stream IDs (optional, auto-fetched)
- `Members`: Array of member IDs (optional, auto-fetched)
- `IsGroupChat`: Boolean (optional, default: false)

**Filters:**
- Posts with `Delivered: false`
- Posts with `DateOfDelivery <= today + 30 days`
- Posts where user has commented or liked

**Returns:**
- Post details with comments and likes
- Activity information

Get private comments filtered by privacy settings and user permissions.

**Parameters:**
- `SocialPageId`: Stream/Page ID
- `Members`: Array of member IDs for filtering

item.description: Query APIs that combine multiple collections to fetch data.
